notes.title: Mannequin House 2.0 Update!!!
notes.notes:
Hello!
This is Actor!

We’re excited to announce a major update to Mannequin Mansion!

Here’s what’s new:
・Full voice acting
・Significant enhancements to horror effects
・??? added
・Stage adjustments
・UI improvements

Whether you’ve played it before or it’s your first time, 
now is the perfect moment to experience the newly reborn Mannequin House!

We hope you enjoy it!

notes.title: 1.1 update Add vacation mode
notes.notes:
・Added "Vacation Mode,"
where you can freely explore the Mannequin House!
In this mode, you can discover information (13 notes + extras) that isn't available in the main story, so be sure to enjoy it!

・Made minor adjustments to sound and other settings.
